summary: Enhance your career with our Executive Secretary Management and Personal Assistant Course. Gain essential skills for professional success and advancement.
lede: An executive secretary course develops practical ways to coordinate leadership time, information, meetings, and follow-up. It is for executive secretaries, personal assistants, and administrative coordinators who manage competing requests, prepare concise decision materials, and track commitments. Learners practice prioritizing work, controlling calendars, documenting decisions and actions, and organizing confidential records using tools such as Outlook, Teams, OneNote, and Excel.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate executive schedules, information, meetings, correspondence, and follow-up across a demanding office environment.
prerequisites: No formal qualification is required. You should have basic workplace experience with email, calendars, documents, and confidential business information. Familiarity with Microsoft Outlook is useful but not essential. Coding or programming is not required. Advanced digital topics, including AI-assisted drafting and Microsoft 365 automation, are taught at conceptual awareness and operational application level, while calendar design, meeting documentation, action tracking, and records checklists receive hands-on practice.
